bug_semantics: Bandit.WebSocket.PerMessageDeflate.inflate/2 in lib/bandit/websocket/permessage_deflate.ex called :zlib.inflate/2 with no output-size cap and then IO.iodata_to_binary/1, materializing the entire decompressed payload in the connection process heap. websocket_options.max_frame_size only bounded the on-the-wire compressed frame. With permessage-deflate negotiated (Bandit websocket_options.compress and the per-upgrade compress: true both true), an unauthenticated client could send a small high-ratio compressed frame (e.g. zeros at ~1024:1) and force GiB-scale allocations before WebSock.handle_in/2 (CWE-770 inflate bomb). Stock Phoenix/LiveView default compress: false and are not on this path.
flaw_origin: Unbounded inflate was first written in da4027cff7d2b80319e76fe7a32f84beceec490a (Implement WebSocket extension + permessage-deflate support (#39)), which added lib/bandit/websocket/permessage_deflate.ex with inflate/2 as :zlib.inflate(...) then IO.iodata_to_binary() and no ratio/output cap. Immediate parent 8968834cea815c31df6aaa6919e0a4f103b2418d (Version bump to 0.5.8) has no permessage_deflate.ex and no zlib.inflate in the websocket tree. 8156921a51e684a951221da7bc30a70a022f722e is the first commit that switches to :zlib.safeInflate/2 with a max_inflate_ratio budget (default 25:1) and :too_much_inflation.
